items.title: Nepal beat Canada by 24 runs to open League 2 tri-series
items.desc: Rohit Paudel’s century and a collective bowling effort give Nepal a winning start in Oman, keeping their hopes of retaining ODI status alive.

items.title: No school, but a graduation cap for women dairy farmers
items.desc: Fifty-six women farmers in Sindhuli have completed four years of training under a Korea-Nepal initiative. They learned modern dairy farming, animal care and financial management.

items.title: SMS alerts helped avert loss of life in Budhi Gandaki floods, says disaster management chief
items.desc: Dharmaraj Uprety says early warnings prompted residents to move to higher ground, while the flood swept away bridges and damaged settlements and hydropower infrastructure.

items.title: Imran Khan’s party’s provincial government suspended by Pakistan president
items.desc: Khan’s party has been rallying for several days to pressure the government for his release, threatening to march on the capital, Islamabad, in the coming days.

items.title: Nepali Congress vote count halted over demand to enter tallies digitally
items.desc: Candidates have demanded that figures for all ballots counted so far be entered into the computer system before counting resumes.

items.title: Indian capital braces for second day of protests against poll chief
items.desc: Police detained more than 2,000 people during Saturday’s demonstrations, while a court ordered the release of three movement leaders as protesters prepared to gather again in New Delhi over alleged irregularities in voter registration.

items.title: ‘It reminded me of the Bhotekoshi floods’: Gorkha residents recount escape
items.desc: A flash flood in the Budhi Gandaki swept away houses and bridges early Sunday, forcing residents of Chumnubri and Dharche to flee to higher ground in the dark. Five people are missing, and six have been rescued by air.

items.title: Five things to know about the Budhi Gandaki flash flood
items.desc: An estimated 35 to 40 houses and several bridges have been swept away in Gorkha, while a suspected landslide may have triggered the flooding. Five people have been reported missing as rescue efforts continue.

items.title: Bailey bridge restores road link between Rasuwa and Nuwakot after six weeks
items.desc: A 73-metre bridge over the Phalakhu river has reopened the route between the two districts, whose road connection was severed by floods in August.

items.title: Landslide may have triggered flash flooding in Budhi Gandaki, officials say
items.desc: A landslide in Chumchet may have blocked a tributary before water surged downstream. Authorities warn of high flood risks along the Trishuli river as far as Chitwan and Nawalparasi.

items.title: Four people unaccounted for after Budhi Gandaki floods
items.desc: The four locals were living in a shed on the banks of the Ungilung river in Chumchet, Gorkha.

items.title: What we know so far about the damage caused by Budhi Gandaki floods
items.desc: Flooding has swept away houses and bridges in Gorkha’s Chumnubri and Dharche rural municipalities, while a hydropower project’s construction site has also been damaged. The full extent of the damage remains unclear.

items.title: Budhi Gandaki flood washes away three bridges in Gorkha
items.desc: Two suspension footbridges and a steel bridge have been swept away, while several houses have been destroyed or inundated, Nepal Police say.

items.title: Trump calls for replacing Ukraine’s Zelenskiy in tussle over diesel deal with Russia
items.desc: Trump’s move to ease sanctions on Russian diesel exports has deepened tensions with Kyiv, prompting Zelenskiy to accuse Moscow of exploiting the deal even as Russian strikes kill civilians in Ukraine.

items.title: Flood sweeps away houses, bridges in Gorkha
items.desc: Helicopters deployed for rescue and evacuations as rising waters force residents and tourists to flee.

items.title: Malaysia rejects Nepal’s demand to open recruitment to all manpower agencies
items.desc: Kuala Lumpur will retain its list of 25 primary agencies and 250 sub-agencies, leaving the recruitment of new Nepali workers in limbo as Malaysia also announces a minimum wage hike to 2,000 ringgit from June 2027.

items.title: Fiction: Subedar Ba’s ‘Swades’
items.desc: After thirty years, more than half the village had fled. It was now a graveyard of empty mud houses.

items.title: Smuggling networks exploit Nepal’s open border to flood markets with untaxed goods
items.desc: From sugar and fertiliser to clothes, mobile phones and medicines, illicit consignments continue to enter Nepal through southern border crossings, depriving the state of revenue and undercutting legitimate traders.

items.title: Thapa wins the mandate. Can he remake Congress?
items.desc: Thapa’s election as president marks a generational shift, but he inherits a party still divided by factional rivalries and an entrenched political culture.

items.title: Ideology, generational change and the quest for unity at Khula Manch
items.desc: The Khula Manch offered a rare view of political leaders from different parties presenting their failed dreams and new ideas for the future.

items.title: Echoes of an empty assembly
items.desc: What once was the biggest platform for international leaders has become an abandoned international arena today.

items.title: Is the new Nepali Congress leadership a viable alternative force to RSP?
items.desc: The new generation of NC leadership will restore lost political space and become the only alternative to the RSP.

items.title: From ‘cockroach’ post to protest leader: India's Dipke tests Modi government
items.desc: Dipke, 31, ​born in a Dalit family on the lower rungs of India’s caste system, shot to fame this year after his six-word response to Supreme Court Chief Justice Surya Kant’s remarks likening unemployed youth to “cockroaches” went viral online.

items.title: Loud blast at Riyadh airport as travellers evacuated and airlines cancel flights
items.desc: Flight tracking site flightradar24 showed all flights to Riyadh ​had either been diverted or cancelled, with only a helicopter ​hovering over the airport at one point.

items.title: Damaged highways disrupt Dashain travel, airlines prepare late-night flights
items.desc: With over a million people expected to leave Kathmandu Valley by road, the collapse of a section of the Prithvi Highway has stranded travellers and forced authorities to expand transport arrangements.

items.title: Abbas postpones Palestinian elections, sets presidential poll for September 2027
items.desc: Two Palestinian officials told Reuters on Thursday that leaders of Abbas’ Fatah movement and rival Hamas had agreed at a meeting in ​Cairo on Wednesday to postpone the elections.

items.title: Trump says Norway has ‘indelible stain’ for not awarding him Nobel Peace Prize
items.desc: Each year of his ​presidency, Trump has expressed disappointment at his failure ​to win the prize.

items.title: Traffic halted after Lokaha bridge sinks on Mahendra Highway
items.desc: Traffic has been diverted after the middle section of a 50-year-old iron bridge on the Narayangadh–Kawasoti road sagged, raising fears it could collapse.

items.title: After the storm in Nagoya, Arika Gurung searches for her sun
items.desc: Gurung, ranked ninth in the world, carried Nepal’s golden dream to Japan and returned empty-handed. In a candid reflection, she breaks down her darkest defeat and the quiet resolve driving her comeback.
